Meta Test Description: Initialize USB xHCI host controller. Configure USB2 PHY by writing 0x102407 to MIZAR_USB_BASE+0xC200. Read capability registers HCSPARAMS1 HCSPARAMS2 PAGESIZE SUPTPRT2_DW2 SUPTPRT3_DW2 PORTSC_20. Configure operational registers CONFIG DCBAAP_LO DCBAAP_HI CRCR_LO CRCR_HI. Populate Device_Context_Base_Address_Array. Configure Event Ring Segment Table. Set ERSTSZ ERDP_LO ERDP_HI ERSTBA_LO ERSTBA_HI IMOD IMAN. Enable interrupts via USBCMD and MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN0. Run controller. Wait for interrupt. Read USBSTS and PORTSC_20. Perform port reset. Enable wake bits. Read DBOFF. Call set_address(). Configure Input Context. Ring doorbell. Call enumeration(). Call finish(0).
